messages:
Jordan Park: Quick live thread for today's all-hands — 20 min til go. two small agenda shuffles and AV fallback notes.
Marta - AV: AV crew on-site. Pan-tilt cam calibrated, NDI feed healthy. Will run a 30s full-scene loop in 3.
Cam - Moderator: Can we move the roadmap demo 5m earlier? Execs have a hard stop.
Sam - Comms: Fine to shift. New agenda: roadmap demo at 15:55, Q&A starts 16:25. I'll update calendar and pinned post.
Eliot (Product): Heads-up for the demo: we'll show Optimize suggestions with a cost delta example. Please flag if time's tight.
Jordan Park: We'll give Optimize 4 minutes. If questions overflow, collect them for a post-meeting doc.
Ravi - Security: Quick ask 10 Private deploy slide needs explicit note on HSM rotation strategy for audits. Can we have a short slide?
Eliot (Product): Yep. We'll include a one-slide summary of HSM rotation and link to the RFC.
Marta - AV: NOTE: if the NDI feed stalls, fallback is to the HDMI capture on encoder-B. Command to flip endpoint if ingest degrades:
```
sudo cp /etc/stream/encoders/hdmi-b.conf /etc/stream/current.conf && systemctl restart stream-encoder
```
Ana (Infra): Ingest rotate policy active: if packet loss >1% for 30s, route to ingest-eu-west-1. Monitoring alerts in #eng-oncall.
StreamWatcherBot: :warning: ingest-us-west-2 packet loss 1.2% (30s avg). Auto-rotate enabled.
Marta - AV: If captions lag >4s, avoid scene transitions and keep single continuous OBS scene with slides+camera.
Cam - Moderator: For live Qs, we'll surface the top 6 voted in thread. Use reactions to vote.
Sam - Comms: Post-meeting plan: recording + slides + transcript in Drive within 90m if recording succeeds; if not, transcript+slides within 3h.
Eliot (Product): Live question queued: "Will Dedicated burst billing be per-minute or metered differently for GPU-backed pools?"
Jordan Park: We'll ask Ops/Product live. If no definitive answer, Product will publish billing examples and unit costs after the call.
Ravi - Security: One more compliance note: confirm Private supports rolling HSM rotation without service interruption. Need a concise answer for SOC reviewers.
Ana (Infra): Short answer: rolling rotation supported; will post implementation notes in RFC link after the meeting.
Marta - AV: Re: hardware 10 bring 2x spare HDMI, 1x DP, spare pan-tilt battery. Also have backup lav mics in case lectern mic fails.
Cam - Moderator: If we run out of time, we'll take written Qs and follow up via the product thread.
StreamWatcherBot: :recording: Recording scheduled to start at 16:00 UTC  will auto-archive when complete.
Marta - AV: Encoder restart command (quick): `systemctl restart stream-encoder && journalctl -u stream-encoder -n 200 --no-pager` 
Eliot (Product): Minor ask: can we get a timestamped clip of the Optimize demo for the product blog?
Sam - Comms: Yes  we'll clip and share. Please note timestamps in thread during live.
Jordan Park: Final tech check in 5. If anyone can't join green room, keep this thread updated. After the call I'll post owners for follow-ups.
Cam - Moderator: Arriving in green room now. See you all in 5. :thumbsup:
